messages:
Jamie: Opening a quick Q&A spin-off from today's all-hands focused on sales pipeline motions and partner ops. Keep questions short.
Maria: Quick note 12: pipeline health is steadier, but our close velocity is slower for deals >$500k. We'll share mitigation plays.
Sanjay: Question: any waiver on the standard 60-day trial for large enterprise POCs? Some AEs asked for longer trials.
Maria: We can approve up to 90 days on a case-by-case basis if Sales Ops + Legal sign off and we get a scoped SOW. Flag the deal and include expected timelines.
Leah: Partner ops Q: will partners get access to the enablement sandbox? Some EMEA partners asked for hands-on labs.
Leah: Yes 15: certified partners will get limited sandbox access with a 30-day token bundle for demos. Details + onboarding flow in the partner kit.
Noah: Are we changing how co-sell credits are tracked in CRM? Partners say tracking is messy.
Leah: We're rolling a simpler workflow: partner-referred opp tag + automated credit allocation in Salesforce. Pilot for 8 partners, then wider rollout.
Priya: On packaging: should reps lead with Dedicated reserved SKUs or hosted + committed discounts for enterprise prospects?
Maria: For predictable spend and compliance needs, lead with Dedicated reserved SKUs. For pilot/POC use hosted with a committed discount and convert to reserved later.
Sanjay: Small ask: can sales collateral include a single-line ROI blurb about quantization/cost savings for exec decks? Ops wants a non-technical sentence.
Jamie: Use this approved line: "Redwood's model and quantization profiles can reduce inference costs up to ~40% for steady high-throughput workloads while preserving output quality." Drop it into proposals.
Noah: Follow-up: will we provide example TCO calculations for Dedicated vs Hosted? Procurement teams asked.
Maria: Yes, Sales Ops will publish a simple TCO worksheet comparing reserved SKU tiers, expected token volumes, and projected savings. Expect draft by end of week.
Leah: Action items: partner kit and sandbox onboarding doc next Tuesday; CRM co-sell pilot live in three weeks; Sales Ops to upload TCO worksheet and SKU matrix by Friday.
all-hands-bot: Recording + deck uploaded to the all-hands folder within 24h.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. If you need deeper follow-up, ping the relevant owner or add to this thread and we'll triage in the weekly GTM sync. :thumbsup:
